releases.notes: Documentation release. Identical firmware behaviour to 0.2.5; no reason to reflash.
Deleting a file actually removes it. Cache edits no longer require an active sync session.
Fixes rows that offered no Delete button, and replaces the two delete buttons with one dialog.
Remove cached copies from the Sidecar, not just files from the AccessPort.
Device presence tracking, guarded deletion compiled in, larger version on the boot splash.
